remarks: Welcome home to one of the most desirable units in this exceptionally maintained community! Featuring a prime, quiet location, this light-filled townhome boasts soaring ceilings up the stairs and an open-concept design with natural light. Beautiful medium-brown laminate wood flooring seamlessly flows through the spacious living area and up the stairs, complete with a cozy fireplace. The intelligently designed split-bedroom floor plan provides optimal privacy, while the bright, airy kitchen includes convenient indoor laundry and direct access to the attached garage. Step outside to enjoy resort-style grounds, ample guest parking, which is a plus, and a quick stroll to the sparkling community
